author: Meshy (AI-generated shape, CC BY 4.0); Acorn & Ash (clean-up, colours, face and beards); Kay Lousberg (Rig_Medium skeleton)
modifications: Body 1: a round, soft dwarf in a cream shirt and brown shorts. The shape is a Meshy 6 Lite model made from a Meshy picture on the free plan; made game-ready in Blender with Claude through the Blender MCP (tools/art/meshy_body.py, decision 0272): reduced to 8,234 triangles keeping detail in the face, the nose shortened, clean hems cut, coloured with vertex colours, with eyes, brows and a smile laid on the face. Carries all five beards (braids, long, full, stache, chops), our own, modelled in Blender as soft shapes. Skinned to the KayKit Rig_Medium skeleton (CC0) refitted to its proportions and marked softDwarf. Skin is a material of its own (decision 0113). Quantized and Meshopt-compressed with tools/import-model.mjs --quantize

author: Acorn & Ash (dwarf body); Kay Lousberg (Rig_Medium skeleton)

Skinned to the pack's Rig_Medium skeleton, refitted to dwarf proportions with its bone names kept, and marked as a dwarf so the game plays the dwarf moves. Skin is a material of its own (decision 0113). Quantized and Meshopt-compressed with tools/import-model.mjs --quantize
